title: fix: verify MCP deployment health endpoint
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Stops the generic Worker verifier from polling the authenticated MCP root for HTTP 200.
- Verifies `/health` on both `mcp.myceli.ai` and `mcp.pollinations.ai` after deployment.
- Keeps the root MCP transport authenticated and `/mcp` removed.

Checks:
- Deployment discovery tests: 2/2
- Hosted MCP Worker tests: 5/5
- Biome and diff checks

gist.headline: The hive checks its pulse
gist.blurb: The MCP worker now gets checked at the door it actually leaves open. Polli brought a tiny stethoscope; the authenticated transport may continue minding its business.
gist.summary: MCP deployment verification now polls the public `/health` endpoint on both `mcp.myceli.ai` and `mcp.pollinations.ai` instead of expecting an HTTP 200 from the authenticated root transport.
gist.impact: Deployments gain more reliable post-release health checks while the MCP root remains authenticated and `/mcp` stays removed.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a gentle deployment mechanic checking two cozy CRT server terminals labeled with the two MCP domains, each showing a healthy green heartbeat. Small code-plants and flowers grow around the server rack to represent a service quietly staying alive.
